baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus ayah places the two occurrences of ن ف ق at the prohibited expenditure and the identity of the speakers, then names the intended result as the group's dispersal.
baseline_models.mechanism: One lexical field joins outgoing wealth, a tunnel with an exit, and a persona that displays one entrance while concealing another. The speakers try to stop money from going out so the people will go out openly; the policy projects the speakers' own hidden-exit structure onto the supported group.

activation_trace.role: Outgoing wealth supplies the flow that the prohibition attempts to close.
A passage with an outlet turns expenditure into a question of whether a sustaining channel remains open.
The concealed second exit gives the named speakers the same covert topology they impose overtly on others.
The assembled people breaking apart is the desired social consequence of closing the material outlet.

changed_reading.before: They are hypocrites who order that support be withheld until the recipients leave.
changed_reading.after: Their boycott is an exit-control mechanism: they close the outlet for wealth to force an exposed human exit, while their own identity is figured by a concealed outlet.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ayah identifies the actors by what they say and embeds a negative command inside their speech.
baseline_models.mechanism: The utterance is not incidental quotation. A saying that circulates among people can coordinate many holders of resources, and speech that assumes control over another becomes the switch by which a private intention is scaled into collective deprivation.

activation_trace.role: Voiced formulation gives the deprivation plan an executable social form.
A saying spread among people supplies the propagation needed for coordinated withholding.
Control exercised through saying makes the prohibition an attempted rule over both donors and recipients.
The controlled variable is the outward movement of support.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports a hostile sentence spoken by a group.
changed_reading.after: The sentence itself is their instrument: a circulating command recruits a withholding coalition and tries to govern who may remain assembled.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object of deprivation is defined spatially as whoever is at the Messenger, and the projected endpoint is dispersal.
baseline_models.mechanism: The target is not merely a list of poor recipients but a relation of nearness. Withholding is meant to convert presence around a message-bearer into separated sides, so the contested object is the topology of affiliation itself.

activation_trace.role: Nearness and presence define the social relation under attack.
Movement to an isolated side supplies the intended transformation of proximity into separation.
The bearer of a message is the organizing center around which presence has formed.
Dispersal names the destruction of that organized nearness rather than mere travel.

changed_reading.before: Aid is withheld from people located near the Messenger.
changed_reading.after: Economic pressure attacks the fact of being-near: it is designed to dissolve a message-centered social formation into isolated sides.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The human prohibition is answered by treasuries spanning the heavens and earth.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speakers treat a local purse as the decisive valve of survival, but the reply changes scale from a controlled outflow to preserved resources across above and below. Their apparent monopoly is therefore a category error about the extent and custody of provision, not only a failure of generosity.

activation_trace.role: Preserved and guarded resources provide the counter-stock to the locally withheld expenditure.
What is above and overarches the scene expands the resource domain beyond the speakers' reach.
The lower domain completes the vertical totality in which the stores are located.
Depletion is the scarcity logic that the speakers wrongly universalize from their own stock.

changed_reading.before: God has abundant resources despite the hypocrites' stinginess.
changed_reading.after: The reply breaks a claimed local monopoly: the speakers mistake one controllable valve for the whole translocal system of stored provision.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: An explicit human saying is followed by the treasuries of heavens and earth and then by the charge that the speakers do not understand.
baseline_models.mechanism: The saying of a thing can be its indication. On that branch, the ordered world supplies a nonverbal counterstatement to the voiced scarcity policy: the stores indicate a larger economy, but the speakers cannot read what the arrangement itself says.

activation_trace.role: Indication functioning as a thing's saying permits the resource order to answer the spoken command without another quotation.
The visible conceptual fact of guarded stores carries the content of the counterstatement.
Failure of understanding becomes failure to interpret the indication supplied by the stores.

changed_reading.before: Their sentence is rebutted by a theological assertion about ownership.
changed_reading.after: Two modes of saying compete: their voiced scarcity command and the created order's legible indication of a larger resource reality.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening ayah separates a statement whose content is explicitly affirmed from speakers who are nevertheless called liars. This revises speech in the focus ayah from a transparent report into an act that discloses the speaker's operative allegiance and use of truth, even when sentence-level content is not the only issue.

activation_trace.role: Testimony presented as knowledge supplies a maximally explicit speech claim.
The contrary-to-truth judgment falls on the speakers despite the intervening affirmation of the proposition.
Saying as an adopted position lets an utterance reveal governing commitment, not merely propositional content.
The focus prohibition is the later utterance whose pragmatic force is reread through that separation.

structural_cues: 63:1 places human testimony, divine knowledge and testimony, and the lie judgment in one sequence.
63:7 again identifies the group by a quoted saying before exposing their failure of understanding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an affirmed proposition beside a judgment of lying; I infer that sincerity and speech-use, not bare sentence content, control the judgment. A live alternative is that an unspoken qualification alone makes the testimony false.

changed_reading.before: The focus quotation simply records the group's hostile economic opinion.
changed_reading.after: The quotation is diagnostic action: it reveals the speakers' governing commitment to coercion, so their identity is disclosed by what they make speech do.

context_deltas.mechanism: Protective cover for the actors is followed by diversion from an extended way. The focus boycott becomes another asymmetric barrier: the planners remain shielded while the path by which others receive support and stay near the Messenger is obstructed.

activation_trace.role: A protective shield supplies cover for the agents who impose the blockage.
Turning others away gives the social direction of the protected intervention.
An extended traversable path makes the obstruction a channel problem rather than an isolated refusal.
The outgoing support is the particular path closed in the focus ayah.
Dispersal is the downstream effect expected from sustained obstruction.

structural_cues: 63:2 orders self-protection before diversion from the way.
63:7 likewise orders a withholding act before the expected breakup of a group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shield, diversion, path, withheld outflow, and dispersal; I infer one asymmetric access-control mechanism. The alternative is that the earlier blocked way is doctrinal while the later boycott is only economic.

changed_reading.before: The speakers refuse charity to pressure a group.
changed_reading.after: They operate a shielded roadblock: protected themselves, they close a sustaining route so an unprotected fellowship can no longer hold its place.

context_deltas.mechanism: A stamped heart and a guarded treasury are both closures, but they have opposite functions. The heart's closure prevents reception and understanding, whereas the treasury's closure preserves what the speakers wrongly imagine can be monopolized; the focus ending diagnoses a closed receptor, not absence of available provision.

activation_trace.role: A stamp that closes and fixes supplies the obstruction on the receiving side.
The heart is the receptacle whose closure blocks apprehension.
The repeated failure to understand links that closure directly to the focus diagnosis.
Guarded storage supplies a contrasting closure that conserves resources rather than refusing perception.
The focus repetition locates the scarcity error in comprehension rather than in the stores.

structural_cues: 63:3 ends with the same negated understanding formula as 63:7.
The passive stamping follows a faith-then-covering reversal, while 63:7 sets guarded stores immediately before failed understanding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two kinds of closure and the repeated comprehension formula; I assign opposite container functions to them. A live alternative is that treasury storage carries no release implication and serves only as an ownership image.

changed_reading.before: They do not know that divine resources are greater than theirs.
changed_reading.after: Provision is not sealed away from them; their receiving faculty is sealed, so they mistake preserved plenitude for inaccessible scarcity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The admired bodies are compared to gathered timber that stands only by leaning on support. This material scene activates the focus boycott as an engineering attempt: remove external support from a real human assembly and make it lose cohesion, reproducing in the victims the unsupported condition latent in the speakers' own display.

activation_trace.role: A visibly gathered body supplies the apparently coherent social object.
Rigid timber supplies a material assembly that lacks self-directed cohesion.
Leaning and dependence on support provide the mechanical condition whose removal would cause collapse.
Material expenditure is the support the speakers propose to remove.
Breaking by separation gives the predicted failure mode of the deprived assembly.

structural_cues: 63:4 moves from impressive bodies and listenable speech to the image of propped timber.
63:7 states a support-removal instruction whose explicit purpose is breakup.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dependent material structure and later economic support removal; I infer a shared mechanics of cohesion. The live alternative is that the timber image describes only the speakers' inner vacancy and should not be projected onto their tactic.

changed_reading.before: Withholding makes needy people choose to depart.
changed_reading.after: The speakers attempt an engineered structural failure: withdraw the load-bearing support of a fellowship until its assembled form breaks apart.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those who seek to drive others away from the Messenger are first invited toward him for protective forgiveness, then twist their heads and turn away. The focus attack on another group's proximity becomes a reversal: they externalize as forced dispersal the distance they themselves choose.

activation_trace.role: Protective covering from the effect of fault is the benefit available through approach.
Twisting into deviation gives bodily form to their chosen redirection.
Turning away completes the self-imposed separation from the offered approach.
The same message-bearer is the center they refuse and whose surrounding fellowship they later target.
Presence near the Messenger is the relation the boycott seeks to undo in others.

structural_cues: 63:5 begins with an invitation to come and ends with visible refusal and pride.
63:6 closes the offered route before 63:7 quotes the plan to displace those who remain near.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies refused approach followed by a plan to end others' proximity; I infer projection from chosen distance to imposed distance. The alternative is a simpler sequence of independent acts of pride and hostility.

changed_reading.before: They want the Messenger's companions to leave because of deprivation.
changed_reading.after: They try to impose on others the distance they enact themselves: refusing a path toward the Messenger, they weaponize support to destroy others' nearness to him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next saying expands dispersal into a return-to-city scenario in which a self-designated stronger party expels a designated lower party. The focus boycott is therefore legible as the first stage of a sovereignty claim: control subsistence, then control civic occupancy and rank.

activation_trace.role: Return establishes the future civic setting in which the threatened sorting is to occur.
The gathered city turns dispersal into a contest over membership in a common political space.
Forced passage to the outside states openly the spatial result only implied by dispersal.
Dominance and coercive victory supply the claimed authority to rank and expel.
Broken subjection supplies the status assigned to the group marked for removal.
The focus breakup becomes the preparatory social form of the next ayah's expulsion.
Richness after poverty destabilizes the boast that present resource control proves durable superiority.

structural_cues: 63:7 and 63:8 are adjacent quoted policies introduced by the same speaking group.
Each boast is followed by a correction beginning with divine possession: treasuries in 63:7 and might in 63:8.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent deprivation and expulsion programs with parallel corrections; I infer tactical staging from the first to the second. A live alternative is that they are separate boasts linked only by speaker identity.

changed_reading.before: The boycott seeks the practical departure of dependents.
changed_reading.after: The boycott is economic statecraft in miniature, meant to manufacture a lower class and clear it from civic space under a false claim of sovereign strength.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning that wealth can occupy attention generalizes the focus mechanism. The hypocrites try to govern others externally through money, while believers can be governed internally by preoccupation with money; both mechanisms let possessions determine proximity, memory, and action.

activation_trace.role: Being occupied by one thing away from another supplies the internal control channel.
Accumulated property is the object capable of becoming an attentional governor.
Keeping something present after possible forgetting names the attention from which wealth diverts.
Commercial loss reverses the assumption that retaining wealth necessarily counts as gain.
The commanded refusal of expenditure is the external monetary control mirrored by internal distraction.
Failed understanding becomes a failure to value and attend, not merely a missing fact about quantity.

structural_cues: 63:9 turns from the hypocrites' manipulation of spending to a direct warning about wealth and children.
The warning ends in loss, reversing ordinary bookkeeping in which retained assets appear to be gain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies external deprivation followed by internal distraction; I infer that wealth governs through both coercion and captured attention. The alternative is that 63:9 begins an independent exhortation with no backward diagnosis of 63:7.

changed_reading.before: The hypocrites misunderstand who truly owns resources.
changed_reading.after: Their deeper error is allowing wealth to govern relation and attention; the same regime can recur inwardly whenever possession displaces remembrance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus speakers use waiting as a weapon: withhold until another group's cohesion fails. The closing ayat reverse that temporal calculation by commanding expenditure before death, staging a plea for delay, and denying any postponement once the appointed endpoint arrives. Their imagined power over others' future conceals their lack of power over their own deadline.

activation_trace.role: The positive command to send wealth out directly reverses the focus prohibition.
A portion already given reframes held wealth as received allocation rather than sovereign stock.
Temporal precedence establishes the actionable interval before arrival.
Loss of life and power is the irreversible boundary at which retained capacity ends.
Denied postponement removes the delay that the focus speakers imagine they can exploit.
A fixed temporal endpoint supplies the true terminus against the boycott's manufactured one.
Giving wealth as a due right names the action desired too late when delay is no longer available.
The group's future breakup is the deadline the speakers think their waiting can manufacture.

structural_cues: The focus uses an until-clause to make delay causally productive for the boycott.
63:10 repeats expenditure positively before death and voices a request for brief delay; 63:11 categorically denies delay at the appointed term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed expenditure commands and opposed uses of delay; I infer a temporal reversal exposing false mastery of outcomes. The alternative is that the closing deadline addresses individual procrastination without targeting the boycott's timing logic.

changed_reading.before: They wait for hunger to disperse others, unaware that divine resources remain.
changed_reading.after: They mistake delay for sovereign leverage over another group's future, while their own finite window makes timely outflow, not strategic retention, the urgent act.

context_deltas.mechanism: The branch image of rain as provision activates the focus treasuries, sky, fertile ground, tunnel, and running freshwater as one cross-domain circulation system. On this reading, expenditure is not subtraction from an isolated purse but release through a conduit from stored supply toward a receiving field; the boycott attempts to dam that circulation so the social growth breaks apart.

activation_trace.role: Provision figured as descending rain supplies the activating material flow.
Preserved supply functions as the reservoir rather than as permanently immobilized stock.
Sky, cloud, and rain locate the upper stage of the circulation image.
Soft fertile ground supplies a receiving domain in which released provision becomes growth.
A through-passage gives expenditure the spatial form of a conduit.
Fresh flowing liquid links release to the threatened loss of cohesion when flow is stopped.

structural_cues: 63:10 grounds its positive expenditure command in what has already been provided.
63:7 places guarded stores, heavens, and earth in a single answer to a command that blocks outflow.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rain-provision and a reservoir, sky, soil, conduit, and flowing-water cluster; I infer the reservoir-to-field direction and its social analogue. The live alternative is a set of independent abundance images with no hydraulic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Divine stores guarantee that a local refusal cannot create ultimate scarcity.
changed_reading.after: Provision behaves like a circulating ecology: the boycott tries to dam a conduit between stored gift and a living social field, confusing blocked flow with absence of source.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant split mapping of the focus saying into a branch of carrying, rising, and a people setting out. It remains anchored to the focus occurrence and converges visibly with the stated dispersal, but downstream prose should present it as form-distant wordplay rather than ordinary morphology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opening act of saying and the projected departure stand in the same focus sentence.

activation_trace.role: Carrying, rising, and a people setting out lets the utterance itself carry an image of mobilized departure.
Actual breakup of the gathering supplies the focus endpoint that contains the form-distant activation.

changed_reading.before: Their saying describes a hoped-for departure.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the saying is itself a loading-and-setting-out device: speech mobilizes the departure it names.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the focus sky through a non-dominant mark-and-discernment mapping and lets earlier witness and knowledge marks activate it. It remains anchored in the sky and failed-understanding words, but it should be rendered as a secondary semiotic resonance, not as a replacement lexical sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The heavens belong to the stated treasury domain immediately before the claim that the speakers do not understand.

activation_trace.role: A visible mark from which condition is discerned makes the sky a legible evidence surface.
Failure to understand anchors the activation as failed reading rather than hidden cosmology.
A witnessing mark primes the possibility that evidence can be borne by an observable sign.
A distinguishing trace that guides supplies the context link between sign and knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The heavens name the upper extent of divine possessions.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the marked heavens are also a readable inventory-sign: scarcity persists because the speakers fail to interpret the evidence surface above them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it places financial outflow, social departure, and the final breath in one exit pattern. It remains anchored by the focus depletion and dispersal language and the later self, breath, respite, and endpoint cues, but prose should qualify it as a physiological analogy disclosed by the closing sequence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus tactic attempts to retain wealth until people leave, while the surah closes on a self reaching a term that cannot be deferred.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustion and departure of a finite stock establish the focus-side exit pattern.
The loss of life and power turns controlled withholding into terminal inability to retain.
Breath leaving the interior gives the final outflow a bodily image.
Space and respite name precisely what cannot be extended at the endpoint.
The fixed term contains the analogy within the surah's explicit temporal closure.

changed_reading.before: They retain money in order to force other people out.
changed_reading.after: Their tactic is shadowed by an ungovernable exit: no possessor can retain breath or buy respite once the fixed term makes the self itself depart.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a branch for a garment that lies by its condition is combined with admired bodies, propped timber, and the focus concealed-exit identity. It remains anchored in the surah's explicit exterior/interior sequence, but downstream prose should retain it as a material analogy for performed integrity, not claim a literal garment scene.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The speakers' hidden-exit identity is attached to a voiced policy that attacks the support of another visible group.

activation_trace.role: An exterior that lies by its condition supplies the image of counterfeit appearance.
The gathered visible body provides the impressive exterior presented for inspection.
Rigid gathered timber replaces inwardly responsive life with a convincing material shell.
Dependence on an external prop exposes the displayed solidity as unsupported from within.
The shown entrance and hidden exit anchor the mismatch between exterior membership and interior direction.

changed_reading.before: Hypocrites speak falsely and try to remove support from the Messenger's companions.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their social body is a propped counterfeit exterior; they attack authentic mutual support while their own displayed cohesion depends on concealment and props.

strongest_changes: The doubled ن ف ق field turns the boycott into an exit-control paradox: stopping wealth's exit is meant to force people's exit, while the speakers themselves carry a concealed-exit identity.
The target is relational proximity around the Messenger, so deprivation operates as an attempt to redesign social topology rather than as isolated stinginess.
The adjacent expulsion boast reveals the boycott as a staged sovereignty project, while the closing death sequence reverses its claim to control future outcomes.
Wealth governs both externally through coercion and internally through captured attention; failed understanding is therefore also failed valuation.
The exploratory rain, reservoir, conduit, and fertile-ground cluster preserves a circulation reading in which blocked flow is mistaken for absent source.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah sustained several coexisting mechanisms without requiring a single winner: hidden exits, speech propagation, attacked proximity, scale reversal, competing modes of indication, structural support, civic expulsion, temporal reversal, and ecological circulation. Split mappings also produced contained but live readings of speech as setting-out and the sky as a marked evidence surface.
remaining_uncertainties: The tactical progression from boycott in 63:7 to expulsion in 63:8 is strongly sequenced but remains an abductive causal link rather than an explicit statement of stages.
The reservoir-to-field reading depends on cross-domain branch convergence; the same details can remain separate images of plenitude without forming a hydraulic system.
The setting-out and marked-sky outliers rely on non-dominant split mappings and should remain secondary resonances rather than lexical replacements.
The supported-timber analogy can diagnose the speakers alone or illuminate the mechanics of the tactic they apply to others; both directions remain live.
